imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The interdental-cleaner guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 412 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 28.22. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings. The only positions 4–20 attached to non-homepage queries were based on one to three impressions.
searchConsole.decision: No page is labeled Data-led because no query or page had enough repeatable evidence. The discovery signal instead shaped the architecture: three unrelated intents are exposed from the homepage, Library and three department hubs, backed by twelve reciprocal contextual links and a regenerated sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: One impression for ‘beard system’ at position 4, three combined impressions for two CDC jet-lag queries at positions 7–8, and one public-Wi-Fi impression at position 19 were deliberately ignored as too small and unrelated to justify another variation or title rewrite.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the interdental-cleaner guide. The suit-fabric and appliance-service field manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready interdental-cleaner fit matrix that separates access, contact shape, dexterity, dental work, technique and professional-care boundaries instead of ranking products. The suit guide adds a claim-verification worksheet for fiber, weave, weight, construction, lining and care; the appliance guide adds a reusable symptom-to-closeout service record.
authority.cluster: Oral-care authority is strengthened with reciprocal paths from the toothbrush, toothpaste, mouthwash and water-flosser guides. Suit-buying authority now connects fabric, fit, alterations and care. Household service authority connects warranty records, repair-or-replace decisions, delivery records and change-order control.
authority.opportunity: No outreach opportunity was logged: the authority work is the on-site reference asset and reciprocal topic-cluster reinforcement. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Grooming, Style and Life: which between-teeth cleaning tool fits a person’s access and dexterity; how to read suit cloth without turning fiber or ‘Super’ numbers into a quality ranking; and how to prepare, supervise and close an appliance service visit. The oral-care guide serves natural purchase intent, the suit guide expands adjacent wardrobe authority, and the service record explores a fresh household operating problem. Analytics informed crawl architecture, not the topics, because the query samples were too weak.
